audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Kings / Melakhim Aleph chapter 9, first-pass draft aligned to public-domain verse structure; formal witness and historical audit remains required.
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for conditional temple promise, land-loss theology, Tyrian cities, Gezer conquest and civilian killing, forced labor by ethnicity, military class distinction, Pharaoh's daughter, maritime expertise, and gold extraction.

verses.restored: When Solomon finished building house of YHWH, king's house, and all Solomon desired and delighted to do,

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

modern.text: Now when Solomon had finished building the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and had achieved all that he had desired to do,

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֥וֹת אֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵת֙ כָּל חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפֵ֖ץ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת

verses.restored: YHWH appeared to Solomon a second time, as appeared to him at Gibeon.

familiar.text: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

modern.text: the LORD appeared to him a second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.

original.text: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה שֵׁנִ֑ית כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִרְאָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו בְּגִבְעֽוֹן

verses.restored: YHWH said to him, I heard your prayer and plea made before me. I consecrated this house you built, putting my name there forever; my eyes and heart shall be there all days.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

modern.text: And the LORD said to him: “I have heard your prayer and petition before Me. I have consecrated this temple you have built by putting My Name there forever; My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו שָׁ֠מַעְתִּי אֶת תְּפִלָּתְךָ֣ וְאֶת תְּחִנָּתְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְחַנַּ֣נְתָּה לְפָנַי֒ הִקְדַּ֗שְׁתִּי אֶת הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנִ֔תָה לָשֽׂוּם שְׁמִ֥י שָׁ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧י וְלִבִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם כָּל הַיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: If you walk before me as David your father walked, in wholeness of heart and uprightness, doing all I commanded and keeping my statutes and judgments,

familiar.text: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

modern.text: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, with a heart of integrity and uprightness, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,

original.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה אִם תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנַ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלַ֜ךְ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֨יךָ֙ בְּתָם לֵבָ֣ב וּבְיֹ֔שֶׁר לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑יךָ חֻקַּ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹֽר

verses.restored: I will establish throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I spoke to David your father: A man shall not be cut off for you from throne of Israel.

familiar.text: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

modern.text: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’

original.text: וַהֲקִ֨מֹתִ֜י אֶת כִּסֵּ֧א מַֽמְלַכְתְּךָ֛ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעֹלָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי עַל דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֨יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מֵעַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: But if turning you or your children turn from following me, do not keep commands and statutes I placed before you, and go serve other gods and bow to them,

familiar.text: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

modern.text: But if indeed you or your sons turn away from following Me and do not keep the commandments and statutes I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,

original.text: אִם שׁ֨וֹב תְּשֻׁב֜וּן אַתֶּ֤ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְלֹ֤א תִשְׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקֹּתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: I will cut Israel from face of land I gave them, and house I consecrated for my name I will send from my presence; Israel shall become proverb and taunt among all peoples.

familiar.text: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

modern.text: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples.

original.text: וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵעַ֨ל פְּנֵ֤י הָאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת הַבַּ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִ֔י אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמָשָׁ֥ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּכָל הָעַמִּֽים

verses.restored: This house shall become a ruin/high place; everyone passing shall be astonished and hiss, saying, Why did YHWH do thus to this land and this house?

familiar.text: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?

modern.text: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’

original.text: וְהַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן כָּל עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו יִשֹּׁ֣ם וְשָׁרָ֑ק וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְלַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: They shall say, Because they abandoned YHWH their Divine, who brought their ancestors from land of Egypt, grasped other gods, bowed to them, and served them; therefore YHWH brought all this evil upon them.

familiar.text: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

modern.text: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.’” Solomon’s Additional Achievements (2 Chronicles 8:1–18)

original.text: וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָזְב֜וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֣יא אֶת אֲבֹתָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽיַּחֲזִ֨קוּ֙ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וישתחו לָהֶ֖ם וַיַּעַבְדֻ֑ם עַל כֵּ֗ן הֵבִ֤יא יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת

verses.restored: At end of twenty years, in which Solomon built two houses—house of YHWH and house of king—

familiar.text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king’s house,

modern.text: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon built these two houses, the house of the LORD and the royal palace,

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י מִקְצֵה֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י הַבָּתִּ֑ים אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: Hiram king of Tyre had supplied Solomon with cedar, cypress, and gold according to all desire. King Solomon then gave Hiram twenty cities in land of Galilee.

familiar.text: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

modern.text: King Solomon gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, who had supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.

original.text: חִירָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ צֹ֠ר נִשָּׂ֨א אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בַּעֲצֵי֩ אֲרָזִ֨ים וּבַעֲצֵ֧י בְרוֹשִׁ֛ים וּבַזָּהָ֖ב לְכָל חֶפְצ֑וֹ אָ֡ז יִתֵּן֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה לְחִירָם֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֔יר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגָּלִֽיל

verses.restored: Hiram went out from Tyre to see cities Solomon gave him, and they were not right/good in his eyes.

familiar.text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

modern.text: So Hiram went out from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon had given him, but he was not pleased with them.

original.text: וַיֵּצֵ֤א חִירָם֙ מִצֹּ֔ר לִרְאוֹת֙ אֶת הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַן ל֖וֹ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יָשְׁר֖וּ בְּעֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: He said, What are these cities you gave me, my brother? He called them land of Cabul until this day.

familiar.text: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

modern.text: “What are these towns you have given me, my brother?” asked Hiram, and he called them the Land of Cabul, as they are called to this day.

original.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה לִּ֖י אָחִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כָּב֔וּל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Hiram sent king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

familiar.text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

modern.text: And Hiram had sent the king 120 talents of gold.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִירָ֖ם לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב

verses.restored: This is account of forced labor King Solomon raised to build house of YHWH, his house, Millo, wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

familiar.text: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

modern.text: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon imposed to build the house of the LORD, his own palace, the supporting terraces, and the wall of Jerusalem, as well as Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

original.text: וְזֶ֨ה דְבַר הַמַּ֜ס אֲשֶֽׁר הֶעֱלָ֣ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנוֹת֩ אֶת בֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֤ה וְאֶת בֵּיתוֹ֙ וְאֶת הַמִּלּ֔וֹא וְאֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת חָצֹ֥ר וְאֶת מְגִדּ֖וֹ וְאֶת גָּֽזֶר

verses.restored: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, captured Gezer, burned it with fire, killed Canaanites living in city, and gave it as marriage gift to his daughter, Solomon's wife.

familiar.text: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

modern.text: Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

original.text: פַּרְעֹ֨ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֜יִם עָלָ֗ה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת גֶּ֨זֶר֙ וַיִּשְׂרְפָ֣הּ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְאֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּעִ֖יר הָרָ֑ג וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ֙ שִׁלֻּחִ֔ים לְבִתּ֖וֹ אֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹֽה

verses.restored: Solomon rebuilt Gezer and Lower Beth-horon,

familiar.text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,

modern.text: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer, Lower Beth-horon,

original.text: וַיִּ֤בֶן שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת גָּ֔זֶר וְאֶת בֵּ֥ית חֹרֹ֖ן תַּחְתּֽוֹן

verses.restored: Baalath and Tamar in wilderness, in land,

familiar.text: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

modern.text: Baalath, and Tamar in the Wilderness of Judah,

original.text: וְאֶֽת בַּעֲלָ֛ת וְאֶת תמר בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: all store cities Solomon had, chariot cities, horseman cities, and all Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and all land of his dominion.

familiar.text: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

modern.text: as well as all the store cities that Solomon had for his chariots and horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout the land of his dominion.

original.text: וְאֵ֨ת כָּל עָרֵ֤י הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֵת֙ עָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַפָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִבְנ֤וֹת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּבַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: All people remaining from Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who were not children of Israel—

familiar.text: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

modern.text: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)—

original.text: כָּל הָ֠עָם הַנּוֹתָ֨ר מִן הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַחִתִּ֤י הַפְּרִזִּי֙ הַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: their descendants remaining after them in land, whom children of Israel were not able to devote to destruction—Solomon raised them as forced labor levy until this day.

familiar.text: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

modern.text: their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction —Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.

original.text: בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָכְל֛וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַֽחֲרִימָ֑ם וַיַּעֲלֵ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַס עֹבֵ֔ד עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: But from children of Israel Solomon made no slave laborers; they were men of war, servants, officials, officers, commanders, chariot officers, and horsemen.

familiar.text: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

modern.text: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slavery, because they were his men of war, his servants, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עָ֑בֶד כִּי הֵ֞ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַעֲבָדָיו֙ וְשָׂרָ֣יו וְשָׁלִשָׁ֔יו וְשָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו

verses.restored: These were chiefs of officers over Solomon's work: five hundred fifty, ruling over people doing work.

familiar.text: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

modern.text: They were also the chief officers over Solomon’s projects: 550 supervisors over the people who did the work.

original.text: אֵ֣לֶּה שָׂרֵ֣י הַנִּצָּבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל הַמְּלָאכָה֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת הָרֹדִ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם הָעֹשִׂ֖ים בַּמְּלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: Pharaoh's daughter went up from City of David to her house Solomon built for her; then he built Millo.

familiar.text: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

modern.text: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace that Solomon had built for her, he built the supporting terraces.

verses.restored: Three times in year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings upon altar he built for YHWH and burned incense before YHWH. He completed house.

familiar.text: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

modern.text: Three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD, burning incense with them before the LORD. So he completed the temple.

modern.text: King Solomon also assembled a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.

familiar.text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

modern.text: And Hiram sent his servants, men who knew the sea, to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s servants.

translation_notes: The temple promise is conditional. Sacred institutions can be abandoned when covenant practice collapses; holiness is not institutional immunity.
The explanation of land loss through religious failure is ancient theological interpretation and must not be used to blame displaced or colonized people for their own dispossession.
Solomon gives twenty inhabited Galilean cities to Hiram within a royal exchange. The residents' consent and political status are absent.
Gezer is captured, burned, and its Canaanite residents killed before becoming a marriage gift. This is conquest, mass killing, and transfer of land—not a neutral building note.
Surviving non-Israelite peoples are conscripted into hereditary forced labor. Ethnic hierarchy and slavery are explicit features of Solomon's state.
Israelites are spared slave status but militarized and absorbed into royal administration; unequal privilege does not equal freedom from extraction.
Tyrian sailors contribute specialized knowledge to the fleet. Ophir's gold reflects distant extraction and trade whose workers and communities are unnamed.
Pharaoh's daughter appears again through palace location and marriage diplomacy rather than her own testimony.
safety_note: Do not use covenant warning to blame victims of war, displacement, famine, or institutional collapse. Do not sanitize Gezer's destruction, ethnic forced labor, land transfers, militarization, or gold extraction as prosperity.
